info.title: Portaliq Register
info.description: Register containing all schemas owned by the Portaliq external-portal application.

x-openregister.description: Portaliq — the fleet's shared external portal for clients and suppliers (ADR-046).

blocks.markdown:
## Meld een probleem
Dien een melding in — geen account nodig. Bekende melders zien hun eigen meldingen hierboven; een anonieme melding heeft geen koppeling met een account.

portalAccount.title: Portal Account
portalAccount.description: Links an external identity (eHerkenning / DigiD / eIDAS) to the subject reference used for RBAC scoping. Owned by Portaliq's auth edge; never publicly readable. See ADR-046 and openspec/changes/supplier-portal.

audience.title: Audience
audience.description: Which external audience this account belongs to. Open string set (contract v2 A2) — e.g. supplier, client, citizen, organisation, student, parent, external-employee, data-subject, signer, participant, vendor-org. Not enum-constrained so new audiences need no schema change.

identityType.title: Identity type
identityType.description: The external identity provider that authenticated this account. `generic` is a broker-agnostic OIDC provider preset (portal-oidc-broker-login) for a broker that is none of digid/eherkenning/eidas.

identityRef.title: Identity reference
identityRef.description: Pseudonymous identity reference from the IdP (e.g. eHerkenning KvK number for suppliers, or a pairwise pseudonym for clients). Not a raw BSN.

subjectRef.title: Subject reference
subjectRef.description: The reference the domain apps scope their data by (e.g. procest supplierRef). Server-derived; never accepted from the client.

organisation.title: Organisation
organisation.description: The tenant (OpenRegister Organisation) this account belongs to.

displayName.title: Display name
displayName.description: Human-readable name for the portal UI.

email.title: Email
email.description: Contact email for notifications (masked in logs).

needsAlternativeContact.title: Needs alternative contact
needsAlternativeContact.description: portal-notifications-dispatch (WMEBV notificatieplicht fallback, ~Awb 2:11): set true by NotificationDispatchJob after N consecutive failed out-of-band notification attempts for this account — signals an operator must reach the subject by another channel. Reset to false on the next successful dispatch.

lastLoginAt.title: Last login at
lastLoginAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful login.

claims.title: Claims
claims.description: Server-managed per-app claim map linking this account to domain identities: {appId: {claimName: uuid}} (ADR-046 contract v2, A4). Written only by Portaliq server code / admin tooling — never accepted from a client. Collections select a claim via scopeClaim.

portalSession.title: Portal Session
portalSession.description: A bearer session issued by Portaliq's auth edge. Records the minted token id (jti) so sessions can be revoked. Owned by Portaliq; never publicly readable.

accountRef.title: Account reference
accountRef.description: Reference to the portalAccount this session was issued for.

subjectRef.title: Subject reference
subjectRef.description: The subject reference carried in the token (server-derived).

audience.title: Audience
audience.description: The external audience of this session. Open string set (contract v2 A2) — not enum-constrained so new audiences need no schema change.

organisation.title: Organisation
organisation.description: The tenant this session is scoped to.

jti.title: Token id (jti)
jti.description: Unique token identifier (JWT jti claim) for revocation.

trustLevel.title: Trust level
trustLevel.description: Assurance level of the authentication (e.g. eHerkenning EH3, DigiD Midden/Substantieel).

revoked.title: Revoked
revoked.description: Whether the session has been explicitly revoked (logout / admin).

exampleDocument.title: Example Document
exampleDocument.description: A demo subject-scoped content object so the portal object reader is exercisable end-to-end. Carries subjectRef so PortalObjectReader can scope it. Replace with real, app-owned content schemas (procest ships supplierContract etc.).

subjectRef.title: Subject reference
subjectRef.description: The subject this document belongs to; the field PortalObjectReader scopes on.

organisation.title: Organisation
organisation.description: The tenant this document belongs to.

title.title: Title
title.description: Human-readable title shown in the portal.

portalMessage.title: Portal Message
portalMessage.description: A message in a subject's portal inbox (the in-portal realisation of the notification/inbox surface). Subject-scoped by subjectRef, so it is read through the same path as any contribution collection. OpenRegister's notification engine (email channel + `field` recipient kind) can additionally email the subject out-of-band when a message arrives.

subjectRef.title: Subject reference
subjectRef.description: The recipient subject; the field the inbox is scoped on.

organisation.title: Organisation
organisation.description: The tenant this message belongs to.

read.title: Read
read.description: Whether the subject has read the message.

aard.title: Aard
aard.description: WMEBV art 2:10 (2027 readiness): the nature of the message/decision. Optional — rendered only when the contributing app supplies it; absent means no such field renders.

rechtsgevolg.title: Rechtsgevolg
rechtsgevolg.description: WMEBV art 2:10 (2027 readiness): the legal effect of the message/decision. Optional — rendered only when supplied.

termijn.title: Termijn
termijn.description: WMEBV art 2:10 (2027 readiness): the deadline associated with the message/decision (e.g. an objection period). Optional — rendered only when supplied.

referenceId.title: Reference id
referenceId.description: WMEBV ontvangstbevestiging (wmebv-submission-receipts): the receipt's own reference id, shown to the subject and linked from the matching `portalSubmission` proof-log entry's `receiptMessageRef`. Present only on a receipt message; absent on an ordinary domain notification.

dataCopy.title: Data copy
dataCopy.description: WMEBV ontvangstbevestiging (wmebv-submission-receipts): a copy of the WHITELISTED submitted field data — the subject's right to a copy of what they submitted. Present only on a receipt message; never contains a non-whitelisted or raw client field.

portalSubmission.title: Portal Submission
portalSubmission.description: Append-only proof-of-receipt log record satisfying the WMEBV burden-of-proof duty (~Awb 2:25): one row per successful portal create-action, linking to the ontvangstbevestiging `portalMessage` it generated. Subject- and tenant-scoped like any other portal object; backs the subject's right to a copy of their own submission-log entries. See openspec/specs/supplier-portal/spec.md (wmebv-submission-receipts).

subjectRef.title: Subject reference
subjectRef.description: The submitting subject; the field this log is scoped on.

organisation.title: Organisation
organisation.description: The tenant this submission belongs to.

appId.title: App id
appId.description: The contributing app whose `type: create` action was submitted.

actionId.title: Action id
actionId.description: The declared action id that was submitted.

payloadCopy.title: Payload copy
payloadCopy.description: A copy of the WHITELISTED submitted field data — the same map the domain create persisted, never the raw client body.

receiptMessageRef.title: Receipt message reference
receiptMessageRef.description: Links to the `referenceId` of the ontvangstbevestiging `portalMessage` this submission generated.

deliveryStatus.title: Delivery status
deliveryStatus.description: The receipt's retriability signal: `delivered` once the receipt message was written, `failed` when the receipt/log side-effect threw (retriable — the domain create itself is never lost).

portalAuditEntry.title: Portal Audit Entry
portalAuditEntry.description: Append-only, portal-owned audit-trail fact record (portal-session-hardening-v2): written on every portal mutation (create/update/forward), every download, and every session event (login/logout/refresh). Never carries payload content — records THAT a verb happened against a target, not the data. Exposed count-only via MetricsController; never publicly readable. Retention is OpenRegister's records-management concern (Archiefwet) — see openspec/changes/portal-session-hardening-v2/design.md.

jti.title: Token id (jti)
jti.description: The acting/affected session's token id, when known (empty for the download hook, which does not carry one).

subjectRef.title: Subject reference
subjectRef.description: The subject the event belongs to.

appId.title: App id
appId.description: The contributing app recording the entry (defaults to portaliq's own id).

register.title: Target register
register.description: The target register (or, for a forwarded action which touches no register directly, the contributing appId).

schema.title: Target schema
schema.description: The target schema (or, for a forwarded action, the declared action id).

targetId.title: Target id
targetId.description: The target object id (empty for session events and forwarded actions, which have no single object id).

portalNotification.title: Portal Notification
portalNotification.description: Append-only per-attempt log of an out-of-band (email) nudge dispatched by NotificationDispatchJob when a contributing app's manifest `notifications` rule key matches a portalMessage create or a successful status transition (portal-notifications-dispatch). One row per attempt — never updated in place — so the burden-of-proof/audit trail is complete. Never publicly readable; recipients are never exposed via metrics.

accountRef.title: Account reference
accountRef.description: The `portalAccount` this notification was dispatched for; the field this log is scoped on.

organisation.title: Organisation
organisation.description: The tenant this notification belongs to.

ruleKey.title: Rule key
ruleKey.description: The manifest `notifications` rule key that triggered this dispatch (e.g. `message.created`, `status.changed`).

appId.title: App id
appId.description: The contributing app whose manifest declared the matched rule key.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: The out-of-band channel used. Only `email` is implemented; the field is future-proofed for `sms`/`push`.

status.title: Status
status.description: The outcome of this single attempt.

attempts.title: Attempts
attempts.description: The consecutive-failure counter as of this attempt: 0 on `sent`, incremented from the previous attempt's value on `failed`. Reaching the configured threshold flags the account `needsAlternativeContact` (WMEBV notificatieplicht fallback).

portalOidcState.title: Portal OIDC State
portalOidcState.description: Short-lived, single-use server-side storage for one OIDC authorization-code + PKCE round trip (portal-oidc-broker-login). Written by SessionController::oidcStart(), consumed exactly once by SessionController::oidcCallback(); a reused or expired row fails the callback closed. Never publicly readable — it briefly carries the PKCE code_verifier.

state.title: State
state.description: The OIDC `state` parameter — the single-use lookup key for this row (CSRF guard).

nonce.title: Nonce
nonce.description: The OIDC `nonce` this authorization request carried; re-checked against the ID token's own `nonce` claim on callback.

codeVerifier.title: PKCE code verifier
codeVerifier.description: The PKCE `code_verifier` presented to the token endpoint on callback, matching the `code_challenge` sent at start.

org.title: Organisation slug
org.description: The `?org=` slug the login was started for.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: The provider preset the login was started for.

returnTo.title: Return to
returnTo.description: The portal SPA path to redirect to once the session is minted.

expiresAt.title: Expires at
expiresAt.description: When this row becomes unusable — a TTL bound on the whole start→callback round trip, independent of `used`.

used.title: Used
used.description: Set true the moment the row is consumed. A second consumption attempt (state replay) fails closed even if still within `expiresAt`.

portalPage.title: Portal Page
portalPage.description: A data-provisioned portal contribution (ADR-046, portal-page-provisioning). Mirrors the IPortalContributionProvider manifest shape 1:1 so Portaliq's built-in provider can read this object and hand it to the same PortalManifestNormaliser every PHP provider's output passes through. Owned by the app that provisions the page; never publicly readable — the built-in provider is the only reader, server-side.

label.title: Label
label.description: Display name for this contribution in the portal SPA (nav / page title).

audience.title: Audience
audience.description: Which external audience this contribution serves. Open string set (contract v2 A2), same vocabulary as portalAccount.audience — e.g. supplier, client, citizen. Not enum-constrained.

minTrust.title: Minimum trust
minTrust.description: Contribution-level default minimum trust (low|substantial|high, contract v2 A3). Absent defaults to low. Individual collections/actions may override with their own minTrust. Mutually exclusive with an entry's own `anonymous: true` — the normaliser drops `anonymous` on an entry that also declares a non-low minTrust.

status.title: Status
status.description: Lifecycle status. Only `active` portalPage objects are read into any aggregate (authenticated or anonymous); `draft` lets an author stage a page without exposing it.

collections.title: Collections
collections.description: Readable OpenRegister collections this contribution exposes. Each entry mirrors IPortalContributionProvider's collection shape (contract v2/v3).

id.title: Collection id
id.description: Unique within this contribution; referenced by pages[].blocks[].collection.

register.title: Register
register.description: The OpenRegister register slug the collection reads from. A plain string, not an OR object relation — this selects a (register, schema) pair, it does not reference a specific object instance (ADR-062's $ref/format:uuid relation dialect applies to same-register object foreign keys, not cross-register schema selectors).

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: The schema slug within that register.

scopeField.title: Scope field
scopeField.description: The property rows are scoped by (contract v2). Omit or leave absent on an anonymous collection — there is no subject to scope by.

scopeClaim.title: Scope claim
scopeClaim.description: Contract v2 A4: scope by a server-managed portalAccount claim instead of scopeField/subjectRef. Never applicable to an anonymous entry (no portalAccount).

via.title: Via (reverse/forward join)
via.description: Contract v2 A5/A5.2: one-hop join scoping. See the portal-contribution-contract spec for the full shape.

minTrust.title: Minimum trust
minTrust.description: Overrides the contribution-level minTrust for this collection.

anonymous.title: Anonymous
anonymous.description: When true, this collection is included in aggregateAnonymous() and readable with no bearer session. Mutually exclusive with a non-low minTrust on the SAME entry (fail-closed: the normaliser drops anonymous when both are set). Default false.

fields.title: Field projection
fields.description: Read-side whitelist (field-projection change); absent returns the full row.

listable.title: Listable
listable.description: Whether this collection gets a synthesised default page when pages[] is absent.

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: Writable/forwardable actions this contribution exposes. Each entry mirrors IPortalContributionProvider's action shape (contract v2/v3), plus the new `anonymous` field.

id.title: Action id
id.description: Unique within this contribution; referenced by pages[].blocks[].action and by POST /portal/api/actions/{appId}/{actionId} for endpoint actions.

type.title: Type
type.description: create/update write through OpenRegister via the portal's own writer; endpoint bearer-forwards to a domain app's own route (contract v2 A6). Anonymous submission is only meaningful for type=create.

label.title: Label
label.description: Display label for this action in the portal SPA (button/form title).

register.title: Register
register.description: Target register for create/update. Plain string schema-selector, not an OR relation — see the collections.register note.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: Target schema slug within that register.

fields.title: Field whitelist
fields.description: The ONLY client-supplied fields accepted; anything else in the request body is dropped server-side.

set.title: Server-forced values
set.description: Values the server stamps AFTER the whitelist, never client-choosable (e.g. a fixed status transition target).

defaults.title: Defaults
defaults.description: Values stamped over the whitelisted payload server-side (e.g. a supertype discriminator). Applied after the whitelist so a client can never override them.

endpoint.title: Endpoint path
endpoint.description: Instance-local absolute path for type=endpoint (contract v2 A6). Full URLs are rejected (SSRF guard).

minTrust.title: Minimum trust
minTrust.description: Overrides the contribution-level minTrust for this action.

anonymous.title: Anonymous
anonymous.description: When true and type=create, this action is reachable via POST /portal/api/collections/{register}/{schema} with NO bearer session — the write is unowned (no subjectRef/organisation stamped). Mutually exclusive with a non-low minTrust on the SAME entry (fail-closed: the normaliser drops anonymous when both are set, falling back to requiring authentication). Default false.

pages.title: Pages
pages.description: Explicit UI page composition (contribution-manifest-v3). Absent synthesises one default page per listable collection.

id.title: Page id
id.description: Unique within this contribution; the portal SPA's page route segment.

label.title: Label
label.description: Display label for this page in the portal SPA (nav item / page title).

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: An MDI name resolvable by the shared icon registry.

blocks.title: Blocks
blocks.description: Ordered UI blocks composing the page. type ∈ collection|action|detail|richText|cta (PortalManifestNormaliser::BLOCK_TYPES) — an unrecognised type or an unresolvable collection/action reference is dropped by the normaliser, never rendered as broken.

type.title: Block type
type.description: The block's kind — which of the below reference fields applies, and how the SPA renders it (PortalManifestNormaliser::BLOCK_TYPES).
